question: A birdbath is designed to overflow so that it will be self-cleaning. Water flows in at the rate of \(20\) milliliters per minute and drains at the rate of \(18\) milliliters per minute. One of these graphs shows the volume of water in the birdbath during the filling time and continuing into the overflow time. Which one is it?
solution:
Track the amount of water inside the birdbath. Before it is full, water enters faster than it drains, so the volume increases by
\[
20-18=2\text{ milliliters per minute}.
\]
The same amount is added each minute, so the graph rises along a straight line during filling.

Once the birdbath is full, the extra \(2\) milliliters each minute overflow. The volume inside remains at the birdbath's capacity, so the rising segment joins a horizontal segment. Only graph A shows these two stages. The answer is \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
